name: @kickside/channel-ui
title: KickSide Channel UI
description: The channel module's install web components. <kickside-channel-responder-create> is the canonical channel-responder install form: pick a channel (across every connection) and an agent, name it, and create the responder automation. The reference provider binding declares component.create.view.

wippy.description: Builds the channel-responder install and settings web components, served from /kickside-channel. The primary tag kickside-channel-responder-create is the canonical install form the automation manager mounts as the type's create view: pick a channel across every connection and an agent, name the responder, and it installs the automation itself on submit, reporting the outcome via automation-installed { success, id?, error? } plus created { id }, close, submit-state { saving }, and error. It reads the type-id attribute (empty falls back to the canonical responder type) and parent-id, the workspace folder the "+" popup passes; a non-empty parent-id switches the form to popup layout. The bundle also ships kickside-channel-responder-manage (entry channel_responder_manage.js), the settings dialog for an installed responder: it takes the automation id via the config or value object prop ({ id }) and emits change { id, state }, close, and error. Per-tag registry details live on kickside.channel.responder's create_view and manage_view view.component entries.

type-id.description: The automation type (responder binding) id being installed.

parent-id.description: Workspace folder the create popup places the responder under; empty places it at root.

submit-nonce.description: Monotonic host command; each new non-empty value submits the embedded form once.
